session.name: MPI-4 - LTX 2.3 video extend: deconstruct the reference graph, author a stripped single-stage v2v workflow on the bench

goal.original: Work out what in a third-party LTX_Extend workflow actually makes video extension, then build our own minimal version of it - as few new dependencies as possible.
goal.summary: Mechanism identified and reduced to one node (LTXVAudioVideoMask, pad+mask). A 46-node single-stage extend workflow is authored and structurally proven on the bench as ltx_v2v_template.json. It has never been executed - that is the next step, and it needs a real video and the GPU.

next_action.description: Open ltx_v2v_template.json on the bench ComfyUI (127.0.0.1:8188), point Input_Video at a real video file, and run it. Everything about this workflow is verified EXCEPT that it has ever produced a frame. Judge the result at the seam: the last reference frame into the first generated one.

key_decisions: A SEPARATE ltx_v2v file, not a branch inside ltx_i2v_t2v.json - the two front ends are mutually exclusive at the latent, and the audio sockets mean opposite things in each

Extend and lipsync will share that one file: same skeleton, mask polarity flipped (lipsync freezes audio and masks video with max_length='partial'). models.js already points two ops at one file, so this needs no new app plumbing
Single stage for now - no MpiStageLatents, no latent upscaler. The user asked to drop multi-stage for this pass
Input_Ref_Frames became a CAP fed by a derived value, not a literal, so short clips degrade instead of being rejected
SamplerCustomAdvanced over LTXVNormalizingSampler, matching the donor extend graph
constraints: Reference frame counts must sit on the 8n+1 lattice (latent frames = ((N-1)//8)+1). Off-lattice does not error - the mask boundary drifts up to 7 frames, which reads as a bad seam
LTX 2.3 samples a JOINT AV latent: the audio path is structural, not an optional feature, and the audio tail must span the same seconds as the video tail
There is no validate-only endpoint. Do NOT POST to /prompt as a dry run on the user's bench - a 22B model loads before the graph's own ExecutionBlocker stops anything
MpiMath exposes math.* only - no min/max builtins - but floor and ternaries work; MpiClamp covers the rest
Do NOT claim js/data/modelConstants/models.js or js/data/commandRegistry.js while MPI-506 and MPI-507 are live in doing
The workflow lives ONLY in the bench userdata (GET/POST /api/userdata/workflows%2Fltx_v2v_template.json). It is not in the repo yet, by design - it is unproven

resume_prompt: Read .agents/mpi-kanban/state/handoffs/f8166f75-fe2c-49f7-b4d9-aea0ab6b77be.json and run mpi-continue on MPI-4. We are building LTX 2.3 video extension. A stripped single-stage video-to-video extend workflow already exists on the bench ComfyUI (127.0.0.1:8188) as ltx_v2v_template.json - 46 nodes, 77 links - and it is fully verified structurally, by link types, and live in the frontend, but it has NEVER been executed. Read .agents/mpi-kanban/tasks/MPI-4/brief.md first: it explains that the whole extend mechanism is one node (LTXVAudioVideoMask with max_length='pad', which zero-pads an encoded reference latent and masks only the padding), why extend lives in its own v2v file rather than inside ltx_i2v_t2v.json, and which knobs are still open. The next action is to run it on a real video and judge the seam between the last reference frame and the first generated one.
